title: Reducing Data Movement in the Galerkin Product of Block Algebraic Multigrid on GPUs
abstract: arXiv:2607.28891v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Galerkin triple product $A_c = P^T A P$ dominates the recurring per-solve setup cost of algebraic multigrid (AMG). For AMG on systems of PDEs the product is a rectangular-block sparse matrix triple product: for 3D elasticity the fine operator has $3\times3$ blocks, the prolongator $3\times6$, and the coarse operator $6\times6$, a shape no vendor sparse library supports. We map its algorithm space -- classical two-pass, fused-recompute, schedule-reordered, shared-memory-tiled, and inspector-executor variants -- under an explicit DRAM/L2 traffic model, and implement the leading variants in portable Kokkos (CUDA) and native CUDA backends using new PETSc blocked matrix types. Validated on an NVIDIA A100, the model predicts per level which variant moves the fewest bytes. translated_title: 减少GPU上块代数多重网格Galerkin乘积中的数据移动
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.28891v4 公告类型：替换。摘要：Galerkin三重乘积 $A_c = P^T A P$ 主导了代数多重网格（AMG）中每次求解时重复出现的设置成本。对于偏微分方程系统的AMG，该乘积是一个矩形块稀疏矩阵三重乘积：对于三维弹性问题，细算子具有$3\times3$块，延长算子为$3\times6$，粗算子为$6\times6$，这种形状是任何供应商的稀疏库都不支持的。我们将其算法空间——经典两遍、融合重计算、调度重排序、共享内存分块和检查器-执行器变体——在显式的DRAM/L2流量模型下进行映射，并在可移植的Kokkos（CUDA）和原生CUDA后端中使用新的PETSc块矩阵类型实现主要变体。在NVIDIA A100上验证后，该模型能预测每个级别中哪种变体移动的字节数最少。在其指导下，一个带有排序、无搜索调度的共享内存分块内核，在不到可移植Kokkos团队内核一半的时间内移动了更少的字节。
tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种显式DRAM/L2流量模型，用于指导GPU上块代数多重网格Galerkin乘积的算法选择，通过共享内存分块和优化调度，实现了比现有可移植内核更少的数据移动和更快的执行速度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and validates an explicit DRAM/L2 traffic model to guide algorithm selection for the Galerkin product in block algebraic multigrid on GPUs, achieving less data movement and faster execution than existing portable kernels via shared-memory tiling and optimized scheduling.
